releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.12 — sign in, sign up and onboarding. The app now opens on the reference auth screen: violet gradient with floating circles, the gradient logo card, Welcome Back / Create Account copy, email and password fields with show/hide toggles, live 'email available / taken' checks while signing up, inline error banners and the Sign In / Sign Up switch. Creating an account leads to the one-last-step profile screen — gradient avatar styles, your name, a username with live availability and a 150-character bio — and then straight into the chats. Your session is remembered across launches, and Settings now has a Log Out button that returns you to the sign-in screen.
